description: This file defines the `SpanBufferWriter` struct which implements the `IBufferWriter<byte>` interface for managing byte buffers using spans. It provides methods to advance the write position and retrieve memory or span pointers, primarily for use with `Span<byte>` buffers in serialization scenarios.

classes.name: SpanBufferWriter
classes.description: A struct implementing IBufferWriter<byte> for managing byte buffers with Span support, providing methods to write data and handle buffer capacity.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the current position in the buffer by the specified number of bytes.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Returns a Memory<byte> for writing data, throws an exception if unsupported.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Returns a Span<byte> for writing data, throws an exception if unsupported.

methods.name: GetException
methods.description: Internal method to generate appropriate exceptions when capacity is insufficient or method is unsupported.
